_doc: Allowlist for leave-a-copy-behind-guard.mjs Stop hook. Files matching these entries may be deleted/renamed without leaving a copy at the original path. Use sparingly — the default is to preserve. Format: 'exact' = literal path strings (forward-slash, repo-relative); 'patterns' = JS RegExp source strings tested against forward-slash repo-relative paths.
